Refined changelog timeline, search, and mobile controls. Added SEO metadata and sitemap coverage. Added consent-aware advertising. Redesigned homepage and blog artwork. Improved workspace previews and navigation. Polished favicon and FAQ.

Improved SEO, homepage copy, and artwork. Refined responsive workspace previews and navigation. Balanced Focused lyrics within measured glyph bounds. Improved Live Lyrics ad-lib clearance. Fixed empty Group Chat messages. Fitted bubbles to wrapped content. Centered notification text and timestamps. Smoothed equalizer animation across frame rates.

Improved homepage previews and mobile navigation. Kept twelve cards in Vault preview. Fitted Live Scroll artwork; auto-followed active lyrics. Added consistent artist colors. Refined Group Chat bubbles, translations, and pronunciation. Prioritized PlanetMusic in browser and social titles. Refined Contact hero and nearby support links. Fixed split-ad-lib punctuation crashes. Preserved credits on white gradient ad-libs. Matched wrapped bubbles to lyric pronunciation bounds. Anchored new chat entries above typing footer. Glided older rows by arrival height. Reduced visible chat jitter.
Refined player, Deezer, lyrics, and responsive layouts. Added legal pages and improved navigation.

Added selective song exports and settings. Added Deezer ARL support and blog posts. Improved backup imports and merge-safe updates. Refreshed homepage cards, artwork, and hero spacing. Improved Live Lyrics translations and ad-lib persistence. Restored staggered cards and smoother transitions. Opened SongModal immediately. Expanded product promos with new graphics. Refined Vault and mobile Settings ads. Enabled default ads while preserving opt-outs. Updated Vault, Ambient, and Zen backgrounds. Reduced homepage background chat visibility.

Cached SongCard artwork colors. Delayed player color extraction until playback. Refined CJK lyric alignment. Staged Live Lyrics rendering in small batches. Deferred measurements until lines approach viewports. Smoothed player positioning after SongModal entrance.

Precomputed Live Lyrics measurements; reduced scroll recalculations. Refined wrapped ad-lib glyph, translation, pronunciation alignment. Stabilized measurements before initial SongModal reveal. Kept main pronunciation visible. Prevented mobile player-canvas overlap. Scaled active lines; reduced inactive lines. Tightened inline ad-lib spacing. Aligned main and ad-lib text baselines. Added pronunciation-aware ad-lib positioning. Offset non-foreign ad-libs after foreign lyrics. Kept foreign ad-libs correctly classified. Shifted main lyrics beneath foreign ad-libs. Moved following lyric rows down accordingly. Preserved box dimensions, padding, and animations. Alternated Group Chat sides by artist. Opposed ad-libs and following bubbles. Detected single-artist timing outliers adaptively.

Enabled export settings by default. Automated lyrics, sync, and translation preparation. Improved platform-link validation and playback routing. Refined lyrics editing and plain-text display. Updated backup and example Vault data. Added compact workspace information tips. Colored workspace button names in tips. Documented accepted Deezer track URLs. Added sync and Group Chat tests. Tested translation, links, and playback. Stabilized homepage hero during playback. Polished toast icons, animations, and progress. Improved no-change save feedback. Reused artist images across the Vault. Added relevant workspace-tip links. Refined Edit Lyrics examples and guidance. Updated artist-tagging documentation. Preserved mobile editor layout. Preserved ad-lib timings through sync setup. Reproduced BLACKPINK sync timing issues.

Moved translation requests through backend proxy gateways. Queued batches with bounded concurrency. Streamed completed translation results individually. Updated lyric rows as results arrived. Improved Auto Spacing across translated rows. Added proxy rotation, retries, and statistics. Validated request sizes and gateway routes.

Restored direct browser translation requests. Fell back through backend after request failures. Kept translation proxy credentials server-side. Added backend-managed Deezer ARL accounts. Used backend ARLs without personal tokens. Retried ARLs across proxy groups with delays. Honored Deezer rate limits and retry delays. Removed post-download cooldown. Allowed Deezer playback without personal ARLs.
